description: DRAFT. Capability descriptors and the live manifest a device sends when a session starts. Nothing here is persisted by peers; a manifest is valid only for the session it arrived in. The namespace org.ligatureprotocol is a placeholder; the domain is not yet registered.

descriptor.description: One capability a device offers right now. Sent in a manifest and in manifest updates; the offering principal is the sender.

type.description: NSID of the capability type, for example org.ligatureprotocol.capability.clipboard.

scope.description: Whether the capability belongs to a user's session on the device (user) or to the device itself (device). See spec chapter 10.

version.description: Version of the capability type's operation set this device implements.

label.description: Optional human-readable label, for example the name of a display.

params.description: Type-specific parameters. The schema is defined by the capability type's own Lexicon.

family.description: Initial capability families. Each will receive its own Lexicon.

manifest.description: The full list of capabilities a device currently offers, sent after session authentication. A later manifest from the same peer replaces this one; when the session ends every capability in it is withdrawn.
